items.text: Little optimism DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; sidelined all week, expected out after playing through it prior week.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP multiple days, sources per McManus/Garafolo.
items.implication: Eagles WR1 role opens; Hurts targets redistribute with Goedert also sidelined.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on IR due to hamstring injury sustained/aggravated in Week 3; minimum 4 games missed, no surgery needed.
items.why: Hamstring; coach confirmed at least 4 weeks.
items.implication: Saints RB committee shifts fully to remaining backs for next month-plus.

items.text: Etienne IR creates clear opportunity for Kamara/Miller (and depth) in Saints backfield; aligns with waiver/injury beneficiary analysis.
items.why: IR removes Etienne for 4+; committee expands for remaining.
items.implication: Kamara primary, Miller handcuff/flex upside; priority waivers.

items.text: De'Von Achane torn ACL in Week 3, season-ending; creates top waiver opportunity for Gordon/Wright.
Rams get Puka Nacua back (expected to play) as Eagles prepare without DeVonta Smith; McVay optimistic after limited practices/progress on hip/groin.
items.why: Hip/groin progress; full/limited practices, coach expectation.
items.implication: Elite WR1 returns; Adams volume may dip slightly but both viable.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top-10 play this week (TNF); believes in him despite short week after big usage game.
items.why: High prior usage/snaps; short-week RBs sometimes disappoint but usage supports.
items.implication: Strong start candidate in favorable spot.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) upgraded to full participant Thursday after limited Wednesday; first full since pre-Week 1, feels injury behind him.
items.why: Hamstring recovery complete enough for full work; prior snap count lifted.
items.implication: Full WR1 workload expected vs Titans; high efficiency continues.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (back) upgraded to full practice Thursday after limited Wednesday; minor issue, preferred easing noted but cleared.
items.why: Back 'something small'; full participation confirms availability.
items.implication: Top QB1 locked in; no limitation expected.

items.text: Steelers rule out RB Rico Dowdle for TNF; also Porter Jr. out, others Q.
items.implication: Steelers RB depth thins for TNF; Warren/others elevated.

items.text: Fresh ETR ROS rankings live: Kenneth Walker ranked #3 overall notable near top; also Parker Washington #22, Saquon #30.
items.implication: Elite RB1 ROS value; strong trade/keep signal.

items.text: Pat Thorman Week 4 rankings and Snaps & Pace live: DAL@HOU up-tempo; LAC@SEA slow; actionable for usage projections.
items.implication: Prioritize high-pace games for volume plays.

items.text: Prefers Jonathan Taylor side in 2-for-1 (e.g. Flowers + Montgomery for JT); typically wants the '1' when close, and JT preferred anyway. Trade calc updated.
items.why: ROS value and role edge; calculator supports.
items.implication: Acquire JT in deals; high trade value.

items.text: Texans run game historically broken (YPC ranks bottom-tier multiple years across coaches/backs/OL); unmoved by more work rumors for Marks.
items.implication: Avoid or lowball Texans RBs regardless of volume.

items.text: Kyle Pitts has just 6 targets through 3 games, none inside 10, low aDOT; among worst results relative to opportunity so far.
items.why: Low target volume/aDOT despite snaps; underperforming opportunity.
items.implication: Fade or trade down; TE22-ish range.
items.conflict: Some may still start on name
